Name: Industrial Kitchen and Interior
Author: DustBeauty
Description:
[b]. Designed to match with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5211][color=#57a5cc][b]v1.4 Misc Recolour Pack[/b][/color][/url] and my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5444][b][code][color=#57a5cc][/color][/code][color=#57a5cc]Industrial Furniture Set[code][/code][/color][/b][/url]﻿.
. Including a matching island counter, a bar and a TV.
. The clutters will randomise between 5 sets of designs every day.

The island bar replaces "Deluxe Tree".
The verticle bar replaces the vertical rotation of "﻿Modern Dining Table".[/b]

[b]The farmhouse layout is my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6005][color=#6fa8dc][b]Seasonal Garden Farmhouse V2[/b][/color][/url]﻿[/b][b].[/b]
[code][/code][code][/code]﻿[b]Cacti are released:[/b][color=#1e84cc] [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5310][b][color=#6fa8dc]Succulents Pack[/color][/b][/url][b].[/b]
[b]The fireplace is Mi's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1024][color=#6fa8dc][b]Warm Cozy Fireplace[/b][/color][/url]﻿[/b][b].[/b]

[b]Config options: (open config.json in my mod's folder with a text editor to change them)[/b]
"Interior Structure": true or false
"TV": true or false
"Bars" true or false
"Beams": true or false
"Kitchen fix manual switch": true or false - for players using some of the non-farmhouse redone custom farmhouses to fix the side counter decors.
"Include the Walnut Farmhouse": true or false - Island farmhouse kitchen replacement toggle.

______________________________________________________________________
The stove and cabinet were edited based on eemie’s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/854]classy new interior[/url].
The glass flower vase and some glassware clutter were inspired by the lovely pixel game: [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/865610/Backbone/]Backbone[/url]﻿.[/i]
The TV was inspired by Herbert Hirche/Dieter Rams TV set, 1964.
The fridge was inspired by Smeg.
Credit Pathoschild for the awsome random token feature.
